content.text: If you're a digital creator in Nigeria trying to sell presets online, you’ve likely faced payment processing roadblocks. Stripe, PayPal, and similar platforms exclude numerous countries, leaving you unable to monetize your work. This presents a significant infrastructure problem, stunting your growth and limiting your access to a global marketplace. However, a sovereign commerce infrastructure is here to change that. By using systems that don’t rely on these conventional payment processors, you can regain control over your sales and customer data, allowing you to focus on your craft instead of worrying about payment hurdles.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

This approach sidesteps the limitations imposed by payment processors, creating a more equitable digital marketplace. Sovereign commerce enables creators to maintain complete ownership over their products and customer data while processing transactions through cryptocurrencies. This not only fosters financial independence but also offers more flexible payment options. With the right setup, you can build a store that responds directly to your audience’s needs, helping you establish a brand presence without relying on platforms that exclude you.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of sovereign commerce infrastructure is built on a combination of reliable, free, and open-source technologies. The Edge Commerce Stack, for example, utilizes Cloudflare Pages for hosting and Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, allowing you to run your e-commerce operations smoothly. All transactions are handled through NOWPayments, which enables automatic cryptocurrency payment processing with minimal fees. Each component integrates seamlessly, ensuring that upon payment confirmation, your presets are automatically delivered to customers. This architecture not only provides a robust solution but also safeguards against third-party interference, allowing you to focus entirely on your creative work.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is crafted specifically for digital creators in regions where traditional payment processing is unreliable or unavailable. If you are selling presets, courses, or any other digital products, and have found yourself excluded from platforms like Stripe or PayPal, this solution is for you. Sovereign commerce infrastructure levels the playing field, enabling creators from Nigeria and similar regions to monetize their work effectively. This architecture empowers you to take control of your business, ensuring that financial limitations do not hinder your creativity or your income potential.
Take control of your sales with sovereign commerce infrastructure.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Edge Commerce Stack comprises several components that work in harmony to provide a complete e-commerce solution. You have Cloudflare Pages for hosting your storefront, ensuring fast and reliable access for customers. Cloudflare Workers handle backend processing, enabling complex functionality without the need for traditional servers. Supabase or Google Sheets can be used for order management, making it easy to track sales and inventory. NOWPayments allows for seamless cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring that you can accept a variety of payment options, all while maintaining control over your revenue and customer relationships.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your sovereign commerce solution, start by selecting the Edge Commerce Stack. Sign up for a Cloudflare account and set up your Pages for hosting. Next, configure Cloudflare Workers to manage your backend logic. After that, integrate Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Finally, set up NOWPayments for handling crypto transactions. The deployment process is straightforward, with many resources available to guide you. Within 48 hours, you can have your online store up and running, ready to sell your presets without the constraints of traditional payment platforms.

By leveraging tools like the Edge Commerce Stack, you can set up a fully functional online store that processes payments in cryptocurrency, ensuring you retain ownership over your products and customer data. This approach not only provides financial flexibility but also safeguards against payment processing limitations imposed by traditional platforms.

This stack is specifically designed to eliminate the barriers you're facing in regions underserved by conventional payment processors.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Register for a Cloudflare account to set up your Pages for hosting. 2. Configure Cloudflare Workers for backend logic to manage your store’s functionality. 3. Use Supabase or Google Sheets for storing order data and product information. 4. Set up NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring a variety of payment options. 5. Load your presets into the system and test the complete transaction process to ensure everything works smoothly before launching your store.
Frequently Asked Questions
Why can't I use Stripe or PayPal in my country?

Stripe and PayPal often restrict services based on geographic regions due to regulatory challenges and financial risk assessments. This exclusion affects many creators who rely on these platforms to monetize their digital products.
How does cryptocurrency payment processing work?

Cryptocurrency payment processing involves accepting digital currencies for transactions. Solutions like NOWPayments enable users to make payments directly on-chain, providing an efficient way to handle sales without traditional banking.
What costs are associated with setting up this infrastructure?

Setting up the Edge Commerce Stack involves a one-time fee of $197, covering hosting, backend services, and payment processing. Additionally, there is a minimal transaction fee of 0.5% with NOWPayments, which is significantly lower than traditional payment processors.
Can I sell other types of digital products with this setup?

Yes, this infrastructure is versatile and can be used to sell a wide range of digital products, including ebooks, courses, and software. The system is designed to accommodate various types of digital content.
What level of support is available after deployment?
Upon purchasing the Edge Commerce Stack, you receive 30 days of support to assist with any questions or issues during your initial setup and operation, ensuring you can effectively manage your store.
